description: Allowlist for the en-reference preservation gate (src/multilingual/en-reference-preservation.test.ts). Each key is a corpus unit (a plain row id, or <id>#<n> for the n-th `_` body of a markup row) whose English re-render — render(parse_en(src), "en") — drops or changes content, so all 23 translations inherit the loss. A new lossy unit, a changed render of a listed unit, and a listed unit that now passes all fail the gate. Shrinks only: deleting an entry is how a fix is completed. Regenerate with tools/regen-en-reference-baseline.ts.
